details: The Federal Reserve, under its new Chair Kevin Warsh, maintained interest rates at 3.50%-3.75% during its June 17th meeting. However, the committee's updated economic projections indicated a more hawkish stance, with several officials now anticipating at least one rate hike by year-end 2026, a significant shift from previous forecasts. This signals a "higher-for-longer" interest rate environment as the Fed prioritizes combating persistent inflation. Following the announcement, major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum experienced declines, reflecting reduced investor appetite for risk assets.
title: Hawkish Fed Outlook Under New Chair Warsh Weighs on Crypto Markets

details: The US Senate and House of Representatives have agreed on the "21st Century ROAD to Housing Act," which includes a provision banning the Federal Reserve from issuing a central bank digital currency (CBDC) until December 31, 2030. The legislation explicitly makes an exception for private stablecoins. This move creates a more favorable regulatory environment for private stablecoins by removing the threat of competition from a government-backed digital currency.
title: US Congress Prohibits Federal Reserve From Issuing CBDC Until 2030
